headline: Las Vegas GP: Verstappen holds off Norris by 0.639s as Piastri charges from P17 to the podium
whyCareReason: Verstappen moves to 304 points in P2. McLaren cut Red Bull's constructors gap to 9 points (440-431) heading to Qatar.
teaser: Max Verstappen wins in 1:27:39.624 from Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri (from P17). George Russell recovers to P9 after a late wall brush.
story:
Max Verstappen won an action-packed Las Vegas Grand Prix on Saturday night, 21 November, covering 50 laps in 1:27:39.624 and beating Lando Norris by 0.639 seconds.

Oscar Piastri completed a McLaren double podium from 17th on the grid, +1.529s. Kimi Antonelli finished fourth (+2.574s). George Russell, who had fought Verstappen for much of the race, locked up while trying to pass his teammate, brushed the wall, and recovered to ninth, +13.192s. Charles Leclerc took tenth after a 10-second collision penalty.

Standings after Round 21: champion Antonelli 402, Verstappen 304, Hamilton 267, Russell 264, Norris 264, Leclerc 250. Constructors: Mercedes 666, Ferrari 517, Red Bull 440, McLaren 431. Next is a standard Qatar weekend at Lusail, 27-29 November, with no Formula 1 sprint.
stakes: Antonelli holds 402 points as champion; Verstappen locks down 304; Hamilton (267), Russell (264), and Norris (264) sit three points apart.
rivalryAngle: Russell locked up trying to pass Antonelli late, hit the wall, and still finished ninth, +13.192s.
funFacts: Verstappen's third Las Vegas Grand Prix win and fourth victory of 2026.
The top five finished inside three seconds: Verstappen, Norris, Piastri, Antonelli, Gasly.
Piastri started 17th and finished third; Russell started second and finished ninth.
